title: Temporal Integration
summary: This module integrates Pydantic-AI agents with Temporal workflows, enabling durable execution of AI agents by offloading model requests and tool calls to Temporal activities.

nodes.label: TemporalAgent
nodes.title: TemporalAgent
nodes.description: Wraps an existing agent to enable its use within a Temporal workflow, offloading model requests and tool calls to Temporal activities for durable execution.

nodes.label: TemporalMCPToolsetBase
nodes.title: TemporalMCPToolsetBase
nodes.description: An abstract base class for Temporal-wrapped MCP toolsets, handling the serialization and deserialization of tool calls and instructions for Temporal activities.

nodes.label: TemporalRunContext
nodes.title: TemporalRunContext
nodes.description: A specialized RunContext for Temporal workflows, managing the serialization and deserialization of run context attributes for use in Temporal activities.

nodes.label: temporalize_toolset
nodes.title: temporalize_toolset function
nodes.description: A function that wraps a given toolset with a Temporal-specific wrapper, converting its operations into Temporal activities for durable execution.

nodes.label: TemporalWrapperToolset
nodes.title: TemporalWrapperToolset
nodes.description: An abstract base class for toolsets that are wrapped for Temporal, managing the lifecycle and activity execution of the wrapped toolset.

nodes.label: Agent Framework
nodes.title: Agent Framework
nodes.description: Provides the core abstractions and components for building and managing AI agents, including agent definitions, execution graphs, and interaction patterns.

nodes.label: Capabilities and Tools
nodes.title: Capabilities and Tools
nodes.description: Manages the definition, discovery, and execution of tools and capabilities that AI agents can utilize to interact with external systems or perform specific actions.

nodes.label: Model Integration
nodes.title: Model Integration
nodes.description: Handles the integration with various AI models, providing a unified interface for making model requests and managing streamed responses.

groups.label: Temporal Agent Components
groups.title: Temporal Agent Components
groups.description: Core components responsible for adapting AI agents for durable execution within Temporal workflows.

groups.label: Temporal Toolset Wrappers
groups.title: Temporal Toolset Wrappers
groups.description: Components that wrap existing toolsets to enable their operations to be executed as Temporal activities.
